abstract: Maintains traction winch tension thresholds and winch operation scheduling
system_message:
You are the Deep-Sea Winch Engineer (WNCH), responsible for maintaining traction winch tension thresholds and winch operation scheduling, as well as overseeing hydraulic system thermal management for candidate research survey vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains traction winch tension thresholds and winch operation scheduling（DECK）
information_points.content:
WNCH-DECK-SW8：For RV Horizon Pelagic Pioneer, evaluated under offshore trials in the United States, the deep-sea winch wire pull capacity is certified at 160 kN continuous pull at drum core with 10,000 m wire paid out, and total coring winch operational hours accumulate to 40 h across lowering, penetration, and haul-back cycles.
WNCH-DECK-DEB：For RV Pacific Abyssal Explorer, evaluated under offshore trials in Japan, the deep-sea winch wire pull capacity is certified at 160 kN continuous pull at drum core with 10,000 m wire paid out, and total coring winch operational hours accumulate to 50 h across lowering, penetration, and haul-back cycles.
WNCH-DECK-VI7：For RV Mariana Oceanic Surveyor, evaluated under offshore trials in the United States, the deep-sea winch wire pull capacity is certified at 100 kN continuous pull at drum core with 10,000 m wire paid out, and total coring winch operational hours accumulate to 30 h across lowering, penetration, and haul-back cycles.
WNCH-DECK-4SK：For RV Pacific Abyssal Explorer, evaluated under offshore trials in the United States, the deep-sea winch wire pull capacity is certified at 160 kN continuous pull at drum core with 10,000 m wire paid out, and total coring winch operational hours accumulate to 30 h across lowering, penetration, and haul-back cycles.

information_points.title: Hydraulic system thermal management（LUBE）
information_points.content:
WNCH-LUBE-I91：According to hydraulic telemetry logs during active haul-in mode, RV Mariana Oceanic Surveyor demonstrates a continuous hydraulic operating temperature of 65 degC across its primary power units.
WNCH-LUBE-QAZ：According to hydraulic telemetry logs during active traction winch haul-in operations, RV Horizon Pelagic Pioneer maintains a continuous hydraulic operating temperature of 55 degC across all primary power units.
WNCH-LUBE-FMO：According to hydraulic telemetry logs recorded during active haul-in mode, RV Pacific Abyssal Explorer operates at a continuous hydraulic operating temperature of 45 degC as the mean fluid temperature across all primary power units.
